IS 5182 : Part 25 : 2026 Air Pollution - Methods for Measurement - Part 25 Ammonia
ICS 13.040.20
ICS 13.040.20
CHD 35
CHD 35
1 SCOPE
This standard prescribes the indophenol method for measurement of ammonia in ambient air.
2 REFERENCES
The standards listed in Annex A contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this Indian standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent edition of the standards.
